en: You have confronted and executed Martellus for his heresy and betrayal. It seems Eliphas rescued him from his crashed Thunderhawk and initiated him into the worship of the Dark Gods. What's more, Chapter Master Kyras also pushed him in this direction, confirming his status as a heretic himself.
zh_new: 你已因馬特勒斯的異端與背叛而與他對峙並處決了他。看來艾里法斯從墜毀的雷鷹中救出了他，並引導他崇拜黑暗諸神。更重要的是，戰團長凱拉斯也將他推向這條道路，證實凱拉斯本人同樣是異端。

en: You have confronted and executed Tarkus for his heresy and betrayal. It seems Chapter Master Kyras helped nudge your fallen brother toward embracing heretical tools. From there it was only a short step into the temptations of the daemon weapon known as the Blighted Bolter, and then into madness. There can no longer be any doubt that Kyras is a heretic himself.
zh_new: 你已因塔庫斯的異端與背叛而與他對峙並處決了他。看來戰團長凱拉斯曾推動你墮落的兄弟接受異端工具。從那裡到名為「腐化爆彈槍」的惡魔武器誘惑，再到徹底瘋狂，只差一步。如今再也無法懷疑凱拉斯本人就是異端。
